comments.author: @CountryTravelDocumentary
comments.text: Be honest—what surprised you most about Cuba after watching this documentary: the vintage cars, the colorful streets, the beautiful beaches, or the everyday life of the people? 🇨🇺🌴 Tell us your answer—I’m curious what everyone noticed first!

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: What surprised me most was the everyday life of the Cuban people. 🇨🇺 The vintage cars and colorful streets are beautiful, but seeing how people live, work, and find joy in their daily lives made the strongest impression on me. It showed a side of Cuba that you don’t always see in travel photos. ❤️
